about.heading: About me
about.lead: I develop software that turns complex problems into simple, user-friendly solutions. I can explain difficult technical concepts in plain language and work closely with product teams to deliver great products.
about.paragraph: I deliver products with great care and quality. I am always eager to learn and enjoy interesting challenges - if you are looking for someone who integrates well into different teams and brings enthusiasm for every kind of technology, let me know.
about.metaLeadershipLabel: Professional leadership roles in Scrum teams
about.howIHelpParagraph: From sketch to scale: I connect good architecture with dependable delivery so businesses can move confidently.
about.howIHelpList1: Frontends that feel snappy and are easy to maintain (Angular, Vite, Tailwind).
about.howIHelpList2: APIs and integrations built for reliability and clarity (Java, .NET, Python).
about.howIHelpList3: Repeatable release pipelines and infra-as-code using Kubernetes and Azure DevOps.
about.waysOfWorkingParagraph: Scrum-savvy fullstack developer who tailors products to your needs. I use practical rhythms where they help, and then focus on the right outcomes - not selling processes, but delivering products.
about.waysOfWorkingList1: Product-first delivery: align roadmap and work to measurable outcomes.
about.waysOfWorkingList2: Hands-on development across frontend and backend.
about.waysOfWorkingList3: Pairing, code reviews, and a quality-first engineering mindset.
